current_review.method: Read inherited evidence and define interface/device prerequisites only

count_interpretation.async_cap: 4000 retained visited nodes; 6533 blocked successor edges, not distinct omitted states
count_interpretation.async_closed_zero: No retained native-closed node; not a proof of unreachability. Checked successor events may close resources without retaining the capped node.
count_interpretation.blocking_closed_168: 168 graph nodes in the stated bounded action space, not 168 independent device shutdown trials
count_interpretation.blocking_no_frontier: Exhausted only this enumerator and these finite bounds, not real concurrency
count_interpretation.two_directed_witnesses: Existence of two deliberately scheduled native-closure paths; they do not replace async BFS closed-node coverage
count_interpretation.no_liveness_claim: No fairness, eventual terminal/return, real-time deadline, or deadlock-freedom proof
count_interpretation.pending_nodes: Outstanding resource obligations; not successes and not automatically deadlocks
count_interpretation.closed_scope: Native resources only; main graph seeds contain no Java frames
count_interpretation.negative_controls: Intentional model policies, not upstream defect reproductions; unittest oracle removes fault/unsafe labels
main_graph_exclusions: Java copy and drain Cartesian space

timeout_and_blocking_return.model_fact: A requester timeout requests stop/cancel but cannot discharge a blocking native call; only actual return does.
timeout_and_blocking_return.required_evidence: Actual native return or truthful unresolved ownership; independent implementation evidence for any promised bounded stop.
timeout_and_blocking_return.forbidden_inference: Future.cancel, NOT_FOUND, deadline expiry, or worker exit means native stack returned.

callback_before_submit_return.model_fact: Submit registration, acceptance, and return are one atomic model action.
callback_before_submit_return.required_evidence: Isolated native backend runs callback before submit returns and proves separate adapter-owned operation/session/user_data and any objects still accessible by return handling or callbacks remain protected by independent references. Return handling must not assume the raw transfer still exists.
callback_before_submit_return.raw_transfer_policy: Fixed libusb permits terminal callback-side free before public successful submit return; its success tail no longer dereferences the transfer. Deferring raw transfer free until adapter call/callback references finish is an optional conservative project policy, requiring LIBUSB_TRANSFER_FREE_TRANSFER disabled and coordinated buffer flags and sole ownership, not a universal libusb rule.
callback_before_submit_return.forbidden_inference: Explicit cancel/control stack checks cover every native API stack, or libusb universally requires the raw transfer to outlive the public submit return.

pending_open_start_and_close.model_fact: Open and initial submits are synchronous setup; no pending-open/start API.
pending_open_start_and_close.required_evidence: Defined late-handle cleanup and source/confirmation/start contract; actual implementation interleavings for stop during open/start/close.
pending_open_start_and_close.forbidden_inference: Stopping after atomic open proves cancellation of blocking open/start.

combined_application_stop.model_fact: Native drain is separate from Java owned-array drain.
combined_application_stop.required_evidence: Per-generation publication revocation, native completion, Java/JNI/processing/preview ownership drain, and truthful combined result.
combined_application_stop.forbidden_inference: Existing StopReceipt.confirmed or model native_drain_confirmed alone proves full application drain.

adversarial_reopen_fixture.model_fact: Reopen after old native release while old Java frames remain is used to inject stale deliveries.
adversarial_reopen_fixture.required_evidence: Product restart continues to obey the frozen combined stop gate.
adversarial_reopen_fixture.forbidden_inference: Fixture open success authorizes bypassing full_drain in the product.
